# LP05 fixture grows alongside providers. Format is intentionally declarative.
root project representative.renegade
root scene Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider project project.startup_scene Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider project project.startup_flow Content/Flow/Main.renegade-flow
provider project project.startup_screen Content/UI/Main.renegade-screen
provider story-flow story_flow.level[0].scene_path_hint Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
provider story-flow story_flow.level[1].scene_path_hint Content/Scenes/Secondary.wiscene
provider runtime-screen runtime_screen.image[0].resource Content/UI/background.png
provider runtime-screen runtime_screen.font[0].resource Content/UI/missing-font.ttf
provider lua-policy lua.declared_dependency.shared[0] Content/Scripts/shared.lua
diagnose lua-policy lua.dofile[0] undeclared-computed-reference script_root..next_script
provider wiscene material[0].base_color Content/Textures/albedo.png
provider wiscene material[0].normal Content/Textures/missing-normal.png
provider wiscene light[0].lens_flare[0] Content/Textures/flare.png
provider wiscene environment_probe[0].texture Content/Textures/probe.dds
provider wiscene weather[0].sky_map Content/Textures/sky.dds
provider wiscene weather[0].color_grading_map Content/Textures/grade.png
provider wiscene weather[0].cloud_weather_map_first Content/Textures/cloud-first.png
provider wiscene weather[0].cloud_weather_map_second Content/Textures/cloud-second.png
provider wiscene sound[0].filename Content/Audio/ambient.ogg
provider wiscene video[0].filename Content/Video/intro.mp4
provider wiscene script[0].filename Content/Scripts/main.lua
expect scene Content/Scenes/Secondary.wiscene
expect screen Content/UI/Main.renegade-screen
expect missing Content/UI/missing-font.ttf
reject outside ../outside-project.txt
reject metadata Content/Looks/like-a-path.png
collision Content/Textures/Stone.png Content/Textures/stone.png
closure project flow scene script nested-script
cycle scene Content/Scenes/Secondary.wiscene Content/Scenes/Startup.wiscene
cycle script Content/Scripts/shared.lua Content/Scripts/main.lua
serialize renegade-dependency-graph version=1 deterministic=true
package proof-executable Tools/RenegadeDependencyProcessFixture.exe
package proof-project Proof/LP05
verify separate-process-runs 2
verify project-inputs-byte-identical true
